title: How Flock's CEO plans to "stop crime"

author: Adam Conover
description:
You may have heard of Flock cameras, a network of automatic license plate readers that track not only license plates, but what vehicles look like, and even descriptions of people inside them. If this sounds like the makings of a surveillance network that is both antithetical to our values, and ripe for abuse: it is! And here to talk about it is Chad Marlow, senior policy counsel at the ACLU, which has defended Americans’ rights against governmental overreach for over 100 years. Today we discuss privacy, surveillance, and how we can combat our current Big Brother dystopia.
